items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I wish I had gotten to know him better, because what there was in the music was a man of considerable depth.

ctx.x: Did you encounter Vic Dickenson in Boston?

Oh, my gosh, Vic Dickenson played the Savoy often. One of the pleasures of jazz to me is its humor, its wit. Vic Dickenson embodied that. He was a quiet, reticent sort of guy, but I wish I had gotten to know him better, because what there was in the music was a man of considerable depth.
